messages:
jen: heads-up — noticed paging didn't go out for prod PagerFlow alerts around 10:42 UTC. Slack alerts posted, but no PD pages :thinking_face:
ops-bot: IncidentBot detected outgoing webhook errors: notify-proxy -> pagerflow webhook returned 500/401 intermittently. sample log:
```
2026-03-18T10:42:12Z notify-proxy OUTGOING /webhook/pagerflow -> 401 Unauthorized hmac-mismatch
2026-03-18T10:42:13Z notify-proxy OUTGOING /webhook/pagerflow -> 500 InternalServerError upstream
2026-03-18T10:42:15Z notify-proxy RETRY suppressed by suppressor window (0 retries left)
```
matt: I'm oncall now — I got the Slack message but no pager at 10:42. checked PD: no incoming webhook events logged for our service at that time.
claire: digging into notify-proxy logs, looks like a signing key rotation rolled out to canary but the header format changed. link: https://logs.redwood/internal/abcd (redacted) — repeated 401s from PD endpoint.
jen: can we temporarily disable the new signing header? if we don't get pages we need manual escalation.
matt: yes — I'll trigger manual page and open the incident in PD. @oncall-tilly can you confirm manual page pickup?
oncall-tilly: Ack — received manual page from PD UI at 10:46 and acknowledged. mobile confirmed.
sre-lead: quick RCA summary: signing-rotation job introduced optional "X-RW-Signature-V2" header. PD's webhook verification rejects when V2 present without legacy fallback -> 401. Our automation marked the webhook error as transient and suppressor blocked retries because the route considered rate/duplicate risk low.
jen: workaround in place? I have a hotfix patch to revert signing header change and restart notify-proxy canary. command: `./deploy --service notify-proxy --image notify-proxy:hotfix-1799 --canary 5%`
ops-bot: Deploy started for notify-proxy:hotfix-1799 -> canary 5%. health checks passing, outgoing webhook responses returning 200 within 30s of rollout.
matt: pages resumed — PD shows successful webhook deliveries at 10:48 and escalations occurred correctly. seems like ~6 customers had delayed pages (6 min window) but no missed final escalations.
jen: good. action items: 1) postmortem + timeline 2) add integration test for signing header variations 3) change suppressor rule so 401 auth failures don't silence paging. tagging: postmortem / ops-followup :eyes:
sre-lead: I'll own the postmortem and put a patch to the suppressor rule. also will add a canary smoke test that hits PD webhook after signing rotations.
jen: thanks — leaving incident channel for a bit to watch for flaps. :thumbsup:
__meta: generated for dataset: realistic slack incident thread about paging integration and bot automation failures
